authority: Bead claude-juoz.3.11; active published catalog and marketplace-visible corpus
semantics: Family-name matches are review candidates, not automatic quality or retirement verdicts.
prefix_policy: A candidate must equal <pack-prefix>-<family>; versioned aliases cover known historical naming drift, while other suffix-only matches are reported but excluded.

explicit_non_candidates.customerio-pack/customerio-primary-workf: content-specific Customer.io campaign workflow, not the generic core-workflow-a family
explicit_non_candidates.customerio-pack/customerio-core-feature: content-specific Customer.io transactional messaging workflow, not the generic core-workflow-b family
explicit_non_candidates.customerio-pack/customerio-deploy-pipeli: content-specific deployment workflow, not the generic deploy-integration family

scope_exclusions.cohort: local ignored or untracked SaaS directories
scope_exclusions.policy: Filesystem-only pack roots cannot change this deterministic report; a pack must be tracked and published in the extended catalog.

scope_exclusions.cohort: tracked unpublished or quarantined catalog entries
scope_exclusions.policy: Publication policy excludes them from the active marketplace denominator.

queue_policy.ordering: candidate share descending, verification score ascending, candidate count descending, pack name ascending
queue_policy.selection: Select the lowest-ranked pack without an existing direct claude-juoz.3.11 disposition child.
queue_policy.duplicate_prevention: Search existing direct children before creation; never create a second disposition child for the same pack.
queue_policy.wip: At most one pack disposition child may be OPEN or IN_PROGRESS. Create the next only after the prior child is CLOSED or explicitly BLOCKED on a real prerequisite.
